name: Egg Sandwich
description: Over-easy eggs with melted cheese on toasted sourdough, finished with hot sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium. Crack in eggs and season with salt and black pepper. Cook until the whites are set, 2-3 minutes, then flip and cook 30 seconds more.
Lay a slice of cheese over the eggs, cover the pan, and cook until the cheese melts, 30 seconds.
Slide the eggs onto one slice of toast, top with hot sauce, and close the sandwich.
